ideas.title: Investigating the Root Cause of Minnesota's Flawed System
ideas.description: This story would investigate the root cause of the flawed system in Minnesota that let fraud slip through cracks for years.
questions: What were the main factors that contributed to the flawed system?
How can the system be improved to prevent similar fraud in the future?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a deeper issue in the Minnesota system and could lead to significant reforms. I recommend investigating the role of key individuals and organizations in the flawed system.
